text:
sara: Hey team, running into a weird embeddings error in prod after we rolled the TS SDK change — clients getting 400s: "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 768". Happens intermittently when using batch size 8 and our retry/backoff is kicking in.

alex: Can you paste a minimal repro + request id? Is this only TS or also Python/Go?

sara: Repro attached below. Only started after we enabled the new automatic batching in ts-embed v1.4.1. Sample X-Request-Id: req_02f8b7a4. Server returned: HTTP 400, body:
```
{"error":"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 768","expected_dim":1536,"got_dim":768}
```
No obvious client-side transformations.

maria: Quick checks: 1) Are you using mixed models? e.g., some calls route to a 768-dim model and others to 1536-dim variants via smart-routing? 2) Are you concatenating batched results locally before returning to caller?

sara: We only pinned model to "open-embed-large-1536" in config. Routing policy is cost-first but pinned. We do post-process to stack embeddings into a Float32Array for downstream store.

alex: Could be two things: a) auto-batcher is merging requests for different models if model key isn't included in the batch key; b) race in SDK where reused buffer length defaults to last-request-dim. Please share snippet of how you call the SDK.

sara: TS snippet:
```ts
// ts client
const client = new RedwoodEmbeddings({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.init({autoBatch: true});
const res = await client.embedMany(["a","b","c","d","e","f","g","h"], {model: "open-embed-large-1536"});
```
We pass model per-call.

maria: Try forcing batchKey to include model in the options and disable buffer reuse:
```ts
await client.init({autoBatch: true});
await client.embedMany(inputs, { model: 'open-embed-large-1536', batchKey: (opts)=>opts.model, reuseBuffer: false });
```
That would rule out cross-model batching. Also bump request timeout to 30s during repro.

kai: FYI engineering: I saw a similar trace earlier. There's an ongoing bug in the TypeScript SDK batcher where the internal pooled Float32Array isn't reallocated when the incoming request has a different expected dim — poolIndex gets reused and the header with dim is overwritten only for the first request in the batch. Filing INC-54321.

embed-bot: Incident INC-54321 created by kai. Assigned to eng-ml. Priority P1? :rotating_light:

alex: For customers blocked, workaround options: 1) disable autoBatch in the client and run per-request calls (costly but safe); 2) set batch size 1 or enforce batchKey per-model; 3) pin SDK to v1.4.0.

sara: I tried disabling autoBatch — errors stopped for 2 hours. Re-enabled with batchKey option and no errors for 30m. Will run load test to confirm. Thanks.

maria: Also check server-side batching config — if server merges batches from different model variants when they're considered compatible, it could still mismatch if model dims differ. But since you pinned model it should be fine. We'll add extra validation on the server to reject mixed-dim batches earlier with clearer error code and include request_id.

sara: Repro + logs (python example used by QA):
```py
# python repro
from redwood import Embeddings
c = Embeddings(api_key='xxx')
print(c.embed_batch(['a']*8, model='open-embed-large-1536'))
# logs show: resp status 400, body {"error":"embedding dimension mismatch","expected":1536,"got":768}
# header: X-Request-Id: req_02f8b7a4
```

alex: Thanks. I'll attach req_02f8b7a4 to INC-54321 and ask eng-ml to prioritize. For mitigation, ops can deploy a patch to validate dims at the router level and reject cross-model batch merges.

kai: Patch note: adding a check in batch router to include model_dim in batch key; deploying to staging in 10m. If validated, will push to canary.

sara: Good plan. One more ask: can we get guidance for SDK retry logic? Right now our retry stacks up 3 attempts with exponential backoff, but when the error is a schema/dim mismatch the retries just flood the router with identical bad requests. Should the SDK treat 400 schema errors as non-retriable?

maria: Yes — client should consider 4xx embedding schema errors non-retriable. We'll add a small change to classify errors with code "embedding dimension mismatch" as terminal and not retried. Also add an opt-in `nonRetriableCodes` list for customers.

alex: Action items: (1) ENG-ML: INC-54321 fix batcher pool reuse + router dim-key (kai) (2) SDK: classify dim-mismatch 400 as non-retriable + expose nonRetriableCodes (maria) (3) Support/Ops: for affected customers, suggest disabling autoBatch or set batchKey/workaround (sara)

sara: Thanks all — I'll update the customer with workaround and ETA. Will reopen if we see reoccur. :white_check_mark:
